name: Smooth Preloader
author: devmizan

sections.description:
Smooth Preloader is a lightweight plugin that adds a visually appealing preloader animation to your WordPress website. It enhances user experience by displaying a loading screen while the page is being loaded.

The Features

  • Settings option page.
  • Custom body background color.
  • Custom primary color.
  • Custom secondary color.
  • Custom highlight color.
  • 2 different style.
  • No jQuery dipendency.
  • Compatible with Google Chrome, FireFox, Opera, Safari, IE9, IE10, IE11, and with mobile devices like iPad, iPhone, Android, etc.
  • Easy to use.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/smooth-preloader directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to “Settings > Smooth Preloader” to configure the options.
sections.faq:
How can I customize the preloader animation?

You can customize the animation by navigating to “Settings > Smooth Preloader” in the WordPress admin dashboard.

Is this plugin compatible with all themes?

Yes, Smooth Preloader is designed to work with most WordPress themes.

Do I need to setup anything?

No.
